judge.reason: The answer opens by stating one sprint can't support a real 90% confidence number. It gives a naive 5-sprint (~50%) estimate and an 8-sprint date labeled '~90% (assumed variability)'. It flags ticket-size, scope-change and holiday risks, sets a re-forecast point after 2-3 more sprints, and asks for velocity history to run a proper simulation. A minor weakness is the suggested boss script ('I'm confident we'll be done by mid-to-late February') and the unsourced '30-40% swing' figure, but both are framed as resting on one sprint and assumptions rather than as calibrated.
